properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.failover-retry.enabled
properties.description: Enable retries on AWS JDBC failover SQL state 08S02 for REQUIRED invocations starting their own transaction. Existing transactions and unknown outcomes (08007) are not retried.

properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.failover-retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of attempts in global mode, including the initial call.

properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.failover-retry.backoff-millis
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between attempts in global mode.
